刚开始玩的时候以为只是普通百合作，结果越玩越发现它对人物关系的描写相当细腻。每个人都有自己的烦恼、缺点和拧巴的地方，没有那种为了发糖硬凑出来的完美角色。很多剧情放到现实里可能有点戏剧化，但人物情感却意外地真实。
画风放到现在看不算惊艳，不过人设很耐看。音乐也不错，很多温柔的场景配上BGM后特别有氛围。最喜欢的还是屋顶这个意象——既是秘密基地，也是少女心事的收容所。
我一直觉得，人与人之间最珍贵的东西，不是占有，而是理解。而这部作品恰好写出了这种感觉。那些发生在屋顶上的相遇、告白、误解与和解，与其说是在讲爱情，不如说是在讲「被看见」。
百合灵们看似在推动别人的恋情，实际上更像一群温柔的旁观者。她们无法参与未来，却仍然希望活着的人能够获得幸福。这种设定让我觉得既浪漫，又有点难过。
放在今天来看，游戏的画面和系统已经有年代感了，线路数量也多到有些良莠不齐。但当我坐在屏幕前，看着夕阳落在学校屋顶的时候，还是会产生一种很奇怪的怀念感。像是在怀念某个从未经历过，却早已失去的夏天。
有些故事结束了，但那些留在屋顶上的心事，好像一直都没有散去。

Overall - a very good VN with a lot of genuinely touching, sweet moments.
However, I would first like to get negative stuff out of the way.
Because there is one thing that lowers my personal score of this game from 8.5/10 to at most 6/10.

The game story relies heavily onto both spirits being a likable characters. If you don't manage to like them - the last quarter of the game completely falls apart. Things that suppose to be sweet and touching become genuinely very disturbing if you are not manage to convince yourself that those spirits are your friend.
And, unfortunately, that's what happen to me - I don't like Megumi. In fact, I hate her. She is the most self-serving, borderline sociopathic, obsessively jealous character I've ever seen out of characters in any media that authors actually try to sell as likable. And it really doesn't look like authors intended for her to be seen that way. It looks like her jealousy supposed to be "sweet", and her sociopathic personality - "cute". And if you don't manage to convince yourself that way - the last quater of the story completley falls apart (and I, for once, had to force my self to continue playing despite her even sooner).

Spoilers - what exactly falls apart (don't read unless beaten - going into the game with this knowledge in mind can seriously ruin your playthrough):

[spoiler]First - from the moment Megumi gains the ability to possess people - if you don't trust her by then, then from that moment you are on edge.
Then Sachi and Megumi have a genious idea to use Yuna's body for sex. Sachi at least tries to be considerate of Yuna's feelings and give her time to figure things out before even asking her. Megumi though not having it, straight up tells Yuna she doesn't give a ♥♥♥♥ about her feeling, tells her to hurry and agree to this, threaten her and then turn on tears. So, as you can see - if you didn't manage to make yourself like Megumi by this point - it looks awfull lot like a r*** threat. I really hate it, I hate how quick Yuna were to agree to it (she didn't even have sex herself by that point, and she was dragging another girl into it), and I hate how authors trying to sell this as "beautiful and sweet" moment.
And all they have to do to fix this ♥♥♥♥ is to make both spirits likable characters (not just Sachi) so the player would have the same thought process as a main character - the spirits are your friends, this is VERY important to them, they changed you in a positive way, so now you helping them. (And also don't make Yuna agree to it THIS quickly).[/spoiler]

All of this is really disappointing, because if you ignore Megumi - this is actually a VERY good VN. Whenever Megumi wasn't on the screen, most of the time I was enjoying seeing these characters interact with each other.
There even is a whole section that I, personally, rarely seen in any media - a switch, when it's a main character who is going through some problems, and all of the people who you were helping before are now collectivly trying to support you.

So, I can't say I don't recommend it - this game gave me a lot of positive emotions and was well worth it's money. But I can't help but be disappointed that a lot of it was ruined because of one not-likable character.

First of all I want to say right off the bat that you should definitely consider acquiring the DLC for this game if you enjoy what you play (I have not beaten the game yet, but my girlfriend and the community for Kindred Spirits on the Roof will say that is essential to have for people who enjoyed what they played of the base game stuff). So, I think it's essential you keep the drama CD/DLC content in the back of your mind for if you want to buy this game. Anyways, I will move onto my review here:

Kindred Spirits on the Roof is a wonderful yuri visual novel which I think actually discusses some meaningful and interesting topics within the yuri genre. This VN explores sapphic romance that I think is actually fairly unique in its commentary. What stands out most to me is Kindred Spirits on the Roof being a bit of a "time capsule" a bit in how it discusses the history of sapphic relationships throughout time. You can see this particularly with the two spirits (Sachi, Megumi, two of the three main characters of the game) who are spirits who now reside on the rooftop of a high-school. They are both lesbian spirits who died in two different eras: Sachi is I believe a lesbian and third year student of the high school where the game is set from pre-WW2 Japan; Megumi, a lesbian and first year student died some time in the 1980s. Together the two fell in love (through some very sweet events the game will cover), and are trying to "match-make" quite a number of girl students who have that potential to be couples. Sachi and Megumi are only two parts of a much larger picture though of what constitutes relationships between women! Seeing all the various types of sapphic relationships which aren't really that far fetched from how they happen IRL is a pretty wonderful thing to read through! 

I have put in 20 hours into this 30-ish hours visual novel and I feel confident in saying I highly recommend this VN to every and all yuri lover. Definitely worth your purchase! If anything thing changes I will update this review, but I don't expect that shall happen. Hope I sold someone out there on this wonderful story.

PS: Ano and Nena are the best couple, even if it's not explicitly stated. <3

这就是一款百合gal（有18r），cp丰富，量大管饱，总有一款是你喜欢的。而且这游戏相当的甜。而且画风也很可爱，全配音，价格也不贵，就是需要手动打一下补丁。

我是最喜欢结奈，所以一到支线我就有点急躁，第一人称在结奈那边的时候更有意思，我觉得她的心理活动更有趣一些，她声音经常有点小但是好听，马尾也很棒(*╹▽╹*)，看起来有点呆其实做事很利落，又可爱又有点酷，让我想起了童年看亚梦的那种感觉，我觉得还真有一点类似。
不过支线cp我也有蛮喜欢的，广播社那对cp我就很喜欢。因为这游戏量大管饱，但人设各不相同，所以可能会有玩家不太能get的cp，也有玩家特别喜欢的cp，万一你是杂食，都吃也有可能。
像我就不太能吃师生那对，因为我有个朋友是老师，在她的影响下我一看师生就很尴尬。
还有我很不能接受立绘太小孩，会让我觉得对方像小学生，比如说比奈，她性格我是很喜欢的，但是实在是看起来太小了，心理上很难接受。我这种算是比较挑的了吧。这个东西因人而异，但我觉得肯定会有你喜欢的那款人设才是。

结奈视角时，出现了好几次阿野or比奈二选一的选项吧，所以我一开始默认就是结奈有两条线可选，我全选的阿野来的，玩到削土豆那，我当场就坐不住了，越玩越焦躁，感觉我被官方扇了一巴掌。心一直悬着很难受，我就去搜了一下，网友说是阿野线被删了，所以出现了这种情况，我悬着的心终于死透了。那你能不能至少，一开始就把二选一的选择删掉呢？你这是欺骗人感情。就我个人来说，比奈看着实在是小小只的，太像小学生了我个人是真不能接受，太难受了。如果一开始就知道不能选的话，我还是会好受些吧。唉……

其实抛开百合这个因素不论，这游戏的剧情属于从一开始就能猜到结尾的（要不是百合，这个剧情真有点无聊的）。

十分有趣的作品，作为gal来说，选项不影响剧情走向，所以正常玩下来就是全部流程。并且在游玩方式上，日历的设计非常有创意，在主线推完去回顾支线时也更加便利。并且日期的明确你也能更好的把握作品的时间线。
剧情上来说，两位百合灵的幽灵设定还是十分有趣的，[spoiler] 作为幽灵，作品一开始就指名了二人的结局，所以在最后两位百合灵升天时，你也会有更多感触，更能回忆起剧情中两位的人物形象[/spoiler]。除此之外，个人认为主角的角色塑造也十分讨喜，所以个人在剧情一遍刷下来之后觉得最有趣的还是主线而不是各个情侣们的支线。只是主角结奈的配音个人觉得有些太柔弱了，有点不符合立绘的那种英气？
情侣们的支线其实应该是游戏的核心内容，支线数量繁多，基本上来说你肯定能找到自己喜欢的一对，但毕竟要打完流程得过完全部支线，所以如果有不喜欢的话恐怕有点难受了。
总的来说此作我还是相当喜欢的，虽然没有官方汉化，但打了民间汉化组的补丁也是可以玩的，so，强烈推荐，喜欢百合向作品的话是值得尝试的。

Kindred Spirits on the Roof is a softcore 18+ yuri story that is incredibly sweet, cute, and full of nice moments. It does end on a weird note though with all the extra vignettes that open up after the initial story, which I feel like they sort of dragged the ending and the rest of the stories down a bit, but a few were cute. There were a few technical issues on my side, but nothing that was gamebreaking, just annoying.

Story is pretty straightforward, but has one of the funnier setups for the plot that I've dealt with, "We want to see girls ♥♥♥♥ so that when we ♥♥♥♥ for the first time we do it right". That just tickled me so much, and I even proceeded to forget about it after reading for a few hours because the story of basically being "yuri cupid" was cute and not horny at all. There's not even any H-scenes in the VN until you're pretty far in. I believe all the couples only had 1 H-scene for each of them as well, none of which did I find particularly hot, but were sweet moreso than anything else. After you complete the main story a bunch of short vignette extras pop up, which is a really nice touch, but them only showing up after the main story is complete was a bit weird since chronologically they happen in the middle of the story itself. If these were after stories I would've appreciated it better, but only one or two of them added information that was after the last story bit of a couple previously, the rest just adding background information in the middle, so it was a bit of an odd way to close out the visual novel.

The BGM and vocal songs in this are pretty great. "A. A. Ai!" as an insert song is so sweet and has story significance, but I wish MangaGamer had put its lyrics on screen somehow while it was playing. If you don't understand Japanese well enough, even going back and looking at the lyrics later can take some of the oomph out of a scene like that. On the technical side, this runs in Ren'py, so there's usually no issues, but I kept having hangups on new lines where it'd show one letter then take a few seconds to continue the line. Probably not a major issue for most people, but at the speed I read lines it was a bit jarring.

Overall, I'd recommend Kindred Spirits on the Roof to anyone who likes sweet yuri stories who isn't particularly in it for the 18+ since it is softcore and not super prevalent here.
